name: @asif2bd/umami-mcp

tools.name: umami_list_websites
tools.description: List every website this account can reach, with their UUIDs. Covers both personally-owned websites and those owned by teams the account belongs to. Every analytics tool needs a websiteId, so this is usually the first call.

query.description: Filter by name or domain (substring match).

teamId.description: Restrict to a single team's websites.

tools.name: umami_get_website
tools.description: Fetch a single website by UUID, including its domain, owner and creation date.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.name: umami_get_tracking_snippet
tools.description: Return the ready-to-paste HTML script tag that sends data to this Umami instance for a given website.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.name: umami_get_stats
tools.description: Headline totals for a website over a period: pageviews, visitors, visits, bounces and total time on site. The response also includes a "comparison" block for the equally-long preceding period, so you can report trends.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

tools.name: umami_get_pageviews
tools.description: Pageviews and sessions bucketed over time, for charting traffic. Returns two parallel series.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for bucket boundaries, e.g. "Asia/Dhaka". Default UTC.

tools.name: umami_get_metrics
tools.description: Top values for one dimension, ranked by visitor count -- top pages, referrers, countries, browsers and so on. Returns [{x, y}] where x is the value and y is the count. Note: Umami v3 renamed the v2 "url" type to "path" and "host" to "hostname".

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

tools.name: umami_get_active_visitors
tools.description: Number of visitors active on the site in the last few minutes. Cheap; good for a live check.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.name: umami_get_realtime
tools.description: Live snapshot of current activity: recent events with country, URL, browser and device, plus rollups by country, URL and referrer. Use this to answer "what is happening on the site right now".

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.name: umami_get_event_stats
tools.description: Totals for custom tracked events over a period: event count, unique event names, visitors and visits, with a comparison against the preceding period.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

tools.name: umami_list_sessions
tools.description: Individual visitor sessions with browser, OS, device, country and region. Useful for drilling into who visited rather than aggregate counts.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

tools.name: umami_get_session_activity
tools.description: The ordered sequence of pageviews and events for one visitor session -- their path through the site.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

tools.name: umami_report_utm
tools.description: Breakdown of traffic by UTM parameters: source, medium, campaign, term and content. In Umami v3 UTM data lives here, not in the /metrics endpoint.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

filters.description: Optional Umami filter object to narrow the report, e.g. {"country":"BD"}.

tools.name: umami_report_funnel
tools.description: Step-by-step conversion funnel. Give an ordered list of steps; the report returns visitors reaching each step plus the drop-off between them.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

filters.description: Optional Umami filter object to narrow the report, e.g. {"country":"BD"}.

type.description: Match a page path or a custom event name.

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps, at least two.

tools.name: umami_report_retention
tools.description: Cohort retention: of the visitors first seen on a given day, how many returned on each subsequent day.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.description: Most common ordered paths visitors take through the site, as sequences of pages with a count for each.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.name: umami_report_revenue
tools.description: Revenue over time from events carrying a revenue property, broken down by country, region, referrer and channel. Requires revenue tracking to be set up in Umami.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

tools.name: umami_report_attribution
tools.description: Credits conversions to acquisition channels -- referrer, paid ads and UTM parameters -- under either a first-click or last-click model.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

filters.description: Optional Umami filter object to narrow the report, e.g. {"country":"BD"}.

type.description: Whether the conversion is a page path or a custom event.

step.description: The converting path (e.g. "/checkout") or event name.

tools.name: umami_list_teams
tools.description: List teams and their members.

tools.name: umami_whoami
tools.description: Verify that this MCP server can reach the configured Umami instance and report which account it is authenticated as, plus the permission mode the server is running in. Good first call for diagnosing setup.
